name: KApprove
summary: The approve control: a password popover only when the rules say so, one click otherwise, nothing when a rule approves automatically.

kind.description: none = one click; standard = password unless Passwordless or a password typed here in the last 15 minutes; step-up = password unless Passwordless; way-in (invites, tokens, sign-in methods, widening access) = always the password typed now.

facts.description: passwordless, remembered, automatic: as the server read them for this page.

terms.description: The terms from the snapshot you will submit, never live fields.

busy.description: The busy face while the act runs (default “Starting…”).

notes: The password field has a visible label.
The server proves the person, freshness and scope again when the act arrives.

do: One pending act per form; a second press does nothing until the first settles.
dont: Never ask for a password in chat.
